uncited: *   **Cell Boundaries:** Numerical issues arise when the ray origin is near the edge of a cell.
*   **Gradient Artifacts:** When computing normals, clamping in the gradient computation can produce artifacts at cell boundaries.
*   **Sign Changes:** The algorithm relies on detecting sign changes.
*   **Time Complexity:** The polynomial evaluation and bisection are constant time per cell, $O(1)$.
*   **Memory Complexity:** $O(1)$ auxiliary memory per ray-cell intersection.
